questions.de: Wer schuf einen Film, der 1988 am gleichen Tag in West- und Ost-Berlin Premiere feierte?
questions.en: Who made a film that premiered on the same day in West and East Berlin in 1988?

timeline.labelEn: Loriot's film "Ödipussi" premieres on the same day in East and West Berlin
timeline.labelDe: Loriots Film „Ödipussi“ feiert am selben Tag in Ost- und West-Berlin Premiere

questions.notes: Card offered Otto Waalkes / Loriot / Roland Emmerich; reworked to open. The film is Ödipussi (Kosmos, East Berlin 17:00; Gloria-Palast, West Berlin 20:00).
